close_reason:
Deferred to workspace-design bead (filed adjacent). The bead's two options are both workspace-canonical reshapes, not contacts-server-local fixes:

(a) Drop with_account / seed_object from siblings — touches 4 crates (calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode) and is a test-fixture API regression.
(b) Add them to canonical mail-server (and any other lacking siblings) — touches 1+ crates.

Either path is a canonical-template question requiring a single workspace-wide decision before propagation. Filed as the design discussion; reopen if/when that resolves toward a specific path and this crate becomes the to-be-swept-from canonical.
description:
LOCATION: crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:234-245

SIGNATURES:
    #[must_use]
    pub fn with_account(self, account_id: &str) -> Self { ... }
    pub fn register_account(&self, account_id: &Id) { ... }

PROBLEM:
The two public functions register an account but disagree on the
parameter type: `with_account` takes `&str` and internally does
`Id::from(account_id)`; `register_account` takes `&Id`. Callers must
remember which to use:

    // builder-style
    let backend = MemoryBackend::new().with_account("acc1");
    // method-style
    backend.register_account(&Id::from("acc1"));

This crate also has `seed_object(account_id: &str, ..., id: &str, ...)`
(memory.rs:251-257) — also `&str` for both account id and object id. The
ContactsBackend trait methods (account_exists, create_object, etc.) all
take `&Id`. The result is that the test-fixture surface uses `&str` and
the trait surface uses `&Id` — callers writing test fixtures get a
different type idiom than the production code they're testing.

WHAT CALLERS CANNOT DEPEND ON:
Once both signatures ship in 0.1.x, unifying them is a breaking change.
The next maintainer cannot decide "we should use &Id everywhere" without
forcing every downstream caller of with_account / seed_object to migrate.

WORKSPACE NOTE:
The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server has only `register_account(&Id)`;
no `with_account` or `seed_object` exist there. So the contacts-server
inconsistency was introduced as a localized addition, not propagated
from the canonical. Per the canonical-template rule, either:
(a) drop with_account / seed_object from contacts-server and use
    register_account everywhere (and provide a separate &str→&Id helper
    in test utilities), or
(b) add with_account / seed_object to the canonical mail-server and the
    other 5 extension siblings with the same shape — but first decide
    whether they take &str or &Id and pick ONE.

Existing related bead: JMAP-qz9v.17 already flags that
register_account(&Id::from("")) silently accepts the empty string. The
inconsistency this bead flags is orthogonal (it is about type idiom
mismatch on equivalent ops), not duplicate.
title: MemoryBackend with_account(&str) vs register_account(&Id) — type inconsistency on equivalent ops
